action_items: Optional: set REVENUECAT_WEBHOOK_AUTH to a strong secret in backend/.env before publishing — webhook currently accepts unauthenticated calls in the preview.
Optional cleanup: consider a lightweight ESLint rule (no-use-before-define / react-hooks/exhaustive-deps) around React state in serve.tsx to prevent regressions of the previous TDZ bug.
